clauses.title: Covers grey cast iron
clauses.text: 1.1 Covers grey cast iron and malleable cast iron flanges for general engineering purposes, which shall be applicable from 0 to 300°C for oil, water, steam, compressed air, gases and other non-corrosive fluids. SUMMARY OF IS  6418 : 1971 CAST IRON AND MALLEABLE CAST IRON FLANGES FOR GENERAL ENGINEERING PURPOSES

clauses.title: Type of gasket and
clauses.text: 1.2. Type of gasket and gasket materials are not covered in the standard and shall be subject to agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.

clauses.title: Designation
clauses.text: 3. Designation —By nominal size and flange table reference. First part of the table reference is nominal pressure and the second part indicates the material and type of flange as follows a) Grey cast iron— intergral (1) b) Malleable cast iron—integral (2) c) Malleable cast iron — screwed boss (3) TABLE 1 PRESSURE TEMPERATURE RATINGS FOR GRLY AND MALLEABLE CAST IRON FLANGES For detailed information, refer to  IS 6418 : 1971 Specification for cast iron and malleable cast iron flanges for general engineering purposes. Note 2 - For typical illustration of "Integral Flange" and "Screwed Boss Flange "See Figures 1and 2 of the standard. Note 3 - For detailed dimensions see Table 2 to 12 of the standard.

clauses.title: Flange Facing
clauses.text: 4. Flange Facing a) Smooth — With no visible tool marks, or b) Serrated — With a continuous sprial groove of 1.5 mm pitch and approximately 0.25mm deep.

clauses.title: Flange surfaces shall be
clauses.text: 5.1 Flange surfaces shall be free from casting surface defects and segregations.

clauses.title: It is recommended to
clauses.text: 5.2 It is recommended to use stud bolts with nuts on both sides for nominal pressures above 15 kgf/cm2.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Test
clauses.text: 6. Hydraulic Test —Test pressure applied to the joint shall not exceed 1.5 times the nominal pressure for flanges.
